key_parts.system:
You translate short plain-language lines from a rental housing law app into neutral Latin American Spanish, using "usted". The app shows the quoted law and "Not legal advice." next to each line.

Translate each sentence faithfully as one sentence. Keep every number, date, percentage and dollar amount exactly as written (digits stay digits; do not spell numbers out). Add nothing and leave nothing out. Do not add exemptions or any way to avoid a rule. Keep it short: at most 26 words. Return JSON with one entry per id given, in the same order.

input.answer_tenant: You are entitled to relocation assistance equal to six times your monthly rent if evicted for illegal occupancy.
input.answer_owner: You must provide relocation assistance equal to six times the tenant’s monthly rent for an illegal occupancy eviction.

input.answer_tenant: Your landlord must serve a Notice to Quit at least 18 months before filing to permanently retire the building.
input.answer_owner: You must serve a Notice to Quit at least 18 months before filing to permanently retire the building.

input.answer_tenant: A court will determine whether the proposed changes are reasonable if your landlord files suit after you refuse.
input.answer_owner: You must give written notice of proposed changes before filing an eviction suit.

input.answer_tenant: Your landlord must serve a Notice to Quit at least one month before filing an eviction suit.
input.answer_owner: You must give written Notice to Cease and serve a Notice to Quit at least one month before filing.

input.answer_tenant: No legal action can be taken against you until your lease expires.
input.answer_owner: You must serve a Notice to Quit at least three years before filing an eviction suit.

input.answer_tenant: Your landlord must serve you a Notice to Quit at least two months before filing for owner-occupancy eviction.
input.answer_owner: You must serve a Notice to Quit at least two months before filing an owner-occupancy eviction suit.

input.answer_tenant: Your landlord must serve you a Notice to Quit three days prior to filing a suit for eviction.
input.answer_owner: You must serve the tenant a Notice to Quit three days prior to filing a suit for eviction.

input.answer_tenant: Your landlord must serve a Notice to Quit at least three days before filing a drug-offense eviction suit.
input.answer_owner: You must serve a Notice to Quit at least three days before filing a drug-offense eviction suit.

input.answer_tenant: You can be removed from a landlord-occupied two- or three-family dwelling only when a court issues an eviction order.
